name: hangar-web
description: Project HANGAR SPA — React 19 / TS 5.9 / Vite 7, embedded into the Go binary via embed.FS (SRS v3.0 §3.1).

scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run size

size-limit.name: initial route payload (SRS Phase 16 exit: < 250KB gzipped)

_hangar_notes.versions: Only the MAJOR lines are contractual (SRS §3.1): React 19, TypeScript 5.9, Vite 7, TanStack Router v1, TanStack Query v5, Zustand v5, Tailwind 4, TanStack Table v8. Minor/patch values above are indicative floors; Phase 0 resolves them with a real lockfile.
_hangar_notes.no-component-libraries: SRS §8.1 forbids MUI/AntD/Bootstrap. shadcn/ui is NOT an npm dependency — its components are vendored into web/src/components/ui/ by the shadcn CLI and then owned by this repo. That is why only Radix primitives + cva/clsx/tailwind-merge appear here.
_hangar_notes.css-exception: SRS §8.1 says 'no custom .css files'. Tailwind 4 is CSS-first configured and REQUIRES exactly one stylesheet holding `@import "tailwindcss"` and the `@theme` token block. web/src/styles/index.css is the single sanctioned exception and is enforced by a CI check that fails if any other .css file exists under web/src/. See docs/01_ARCHITECTURE.md §15.3.
_hangar_notes.api-types: `pnpm api:types` consumes the Huma-generated docs/openapi.json. Principle 10 requires this to run in CI and fail the build on a non-empty git diff. Phase 0 commits a minimal valid OpenAPI 3.1 stub so the file exists before Phase 15 fills it in.
_hangar_notes.locales: There is deliberately NO locale sync script. SRS v3.1 §4.6 (defect B7) makes internal/i18n/locales.json the single definition, imported directly by Vite via a filesystem alias. A sync script would create the second copy the requirement exists to prevent.
